And she saw that he was driven from her and her expectation perished, and she took another from her cubs and appointed him as a lion.
And he prowled in the midst of lions; he became a lion and learned to seize plunder; he ate men.
And he prowled in his daring and laid waste their cities and desolated the land and its fullness by the sound of his roar.
And nations from countries around set themselves against him and spread their nets over him; in their corruption he was caught.
And they put him in a bridle and in a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon and led him into prison, so that his voice might no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
Your mother was like a vine, like a blossom on a pomegranate, planted by water; her fruit and her shoot came from much water.
And she had a rod of strength for a tribe of rulers, and she was exalted in her size in the midst of stems, and she saw her size in the multitude of her branches.
And she was broken in wrath and cast onto the ground, and the scorching wind dried her chosen things; her rod of strength was avenged and dried up; fire consumed her.
And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land.
And fire went out from a rod of her chosen ones and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her, a tribe for a parable of lamentation. It is lamentation and will be for lamentation.
And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of the house of Israel came to inquire of the Lord and sat before me.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Is it to inquire of me that you come? As I live, I will not answer you, says the Lord.
Will I avenge them with vengeance, son of man? Bear witness to them concerning the lawless deeds of their fathers.

And say to them, Thus says the Lord: From the day I chose the house of Israel and made myself known to the seed of the house of Jacob and was known to them in the land of Egypt and took hold of them with my hand, saying, I am the Lord your God,
on that day I took hold of them with my hand to bring them out from the land of Egypt into the land that I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, a honeycomb beyond every land.
And I said to them, Let each one cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the practices of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

And they rebelled against me and did not want to listen to me. They did not cast away the abominations of their eyes, and they did not leave behind the practices of Egypt, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to complete my anger in them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before the nations among whom they were, among whom I was made known to them before them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt.
And I brought them out from the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.
And I gave them my ordinances, and my judgments I made known to them, which if a man does them, he will live in them.
And my Sabbaths I gave them, to be a sign between me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.

And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, Walk in my ordinances, yet they did not walk, and they rejected my judgments, which if a man does them, he will live in them, and they greatly profaned my Sabbaths, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness to consume them.
And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
And I lifted my hand against them in the wilderness, not at all to bring them into the land that I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey, a honeycomb beyond every land,
because they rejected my judgments and did not walk in my ordinances and profaned my Sabbaths, and they went after the thoughts of their hearts.
And my eye spared them so as not to wipe them out, and I did not make a full end of them in the wilderness.

And I said to their children in the wilderness, Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their judgments, and do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not defile yourselves.
I am the Lord your God. Walk in my ordinances, and keep my judgments and do them,
and sanctify my Sabbaths, and let them be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the Lord your God.

And their children provoked me. They did not walk in my ordinances, and they did not keep my judgments to do them, which if a man does them, he will live in them, and they profaned my Sabbaths, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness to complete my anger upon them.
And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
And I lifted my hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the lands,
because they did not do my judgments and rejected my ordinances and profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after the thoughts of their fathers.
And I also gave them ordinances that were not good and judgments in which they will not live.
And I defiled them with their gifts, when I caused every opener of the womb to pass through, so that I might destroy them.
Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Thus far your fathers provoked me in their trespasses by which they trespassed against me.

And I brought them into the land about which I lifted my hand to give it to them, and they saw every high hill and every shady tree and there they sacrificed to their gods and set there a fragrant smell and poured out there their drink offerings.
And I said to them, What is Bamah, that you enter there? And its name was called Bamah until this day.
Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Are you defiling yourselves in the lawless deeds of your fathers, and after their abominations are you whoring?

And in the firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are defiling yourselves in all your thoughts until this day, and shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will not answer you. And as for this that rises upon your spirit,
it will not be in the way that you say, We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, serving wood and stone.
Therefore as I live, says the Lord, with a strong hand and an uplifted arm and wrath poured out I will reign over you.
And I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the lands where you were scattered, with a strong hand and an uplifted arm and wrath poured out.
And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and judge with you there face to face.
As I judged with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord.
And I will bring you under my rod and bring you in by number.

And I will pick out from you the impious ones and the rebels, because I will bring them out from their sojourning, but into the land of Israel they will not enter, and you will know that I am the Lord.

And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord God: Each one, remove his practices, and after these things, if you do not listen to me, you will no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and with your practices.

Because on my holy mountain, on a high mountain, says the Lord God, there all the house of Israel, to the end, will serve me, and there I will receive you, and there I will visit your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your separations in all your holy things.

In a fragrant aroma I will receive you, when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the lands in which you were scattered, and I will be sanctified in you before the eyes of the peoples.
And you will know that I am the Lord when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land concerning which I lifted my hand to give it to your fathers.
And there you will remember your ways and your practices by which you defiled yourselves, and you will strike your faces over all your evils.
And you will know that I am the Lord when I act thus toward you, so that my name may not be profaned, not according to your evil ways and not according to your corrupt practices, says the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Teman and look toward Darom and prophesy against the leading forest of Negeb.

And say to the forest of Negeb, Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I kindle fire in you, and it will devour in you every green tree and every dry tree. The kindled flame will not be quenched, and every face from the east to the north will be burned in it.
And all flesh will know that I, the Lord, kindled it, and it will not be quenched.
And I said, By no means, Lord, Lord. They say to me, Is this not a parable being spoken?
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and set your face toward Jerusalem and look toward their holy places, and you will prophesy against the land of Israel.
And you will say to the land of Israel, Behold, I am against you, and I will draw my dagger from its sheath and destroy from you the unjust and the lawless.
Because I will destroy from you the unjust and the lawless, so my dagger will go out from its sheath against all flesh from the east to the north.
And all flesh will know that I, the Lord, have drawn my dagger from its sheath, and it will not turn back anymore.
And you, son of man, groan with breaking of your loins, and with pains you will groan before their eyes.

And it will be, if they say to you, Why do you groan? then you will say, Because of the report, for it is coming, and every heart will be broken, and all hands will be paralyzed, and all flesh and every spirit will faint, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness. Behold, it is coming and will happen, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and be enraged.
So that you may slaughter victims, be sharpened; so that you may become ready for gleaming, ready for paralysis. Slaughter; despise; push away every tree.
And he gave it ready for his hand to seize. The sword has been honed; it is ready to be given into the hand of one piercing through.
Cry out and howl, son of man, because it came among my people; it came among all the leaders of Israel. They will sojourn under sword; it came among my people. Therefore clap upon your hand.
Because it has been justified. And what if a tribe has been rejected? It will not be, says the Lord God.
And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand upon hand and double the sword; the third sword is a sword of wounded ones, a great sword of wounded ones, and it will throw them into panic.

So that the heart may be crushed and the weak ones may be multiplied, at all their gates they have been handed over to slaughter by sword. It has been well made for slaughter; it has been well made for gleaming.
Pass through. Be sharpened on the right and on the left, wherever your face is raised.
And I too will clap my hand to my hand and let my wrath rest. I, the Lord, have spoken.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

And you, son of man, appoint for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to enter. From one land the two will come out, and a hand will be at the beginning of the road, at the beginning of the city's road.
You will appoint a road for the sword to enter upon Rabbah of the sons of Ammon and upon Judah and upon Jerusalem in her midst.
Because the king of Babylon will stand on the ancient road, at the beginning of the two roads, to divine divination, to shake a rod, and inquire by the carved things and inspect a liver. On his right
the oracle came against Jerusalem, to cast up a trench, to open mouth with a shout, to raise a voice with a cry, to cast up a trench against her gates and heap up earth and build missile-stations.
And he will be to them like one divining divination before them, and he himself reminding them of his injustices, to be remembered.

Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you brought your injustices to remembrance, when your impieties were uncovered, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and in your practices, because you were remembered in these things, in them you will be captured.
And you, profane, lawless leader of Israel, whose day has come, an end in a time of injustice,
thus says the Lord: Remove the turban and put on the crown. This will not be like this. You humbled the high and exalted the low.
Injustice, injustice, I will make it. Even this will not be until one comes whose right it is, and I will give it to him.

And you, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord concerning the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach. And you will say, Sword, sword, drawn for slaughter and drawn for complete destruction. Rise up so that you may flash,
while in your vain vision and your false divination, to hand you over upon the necks of wounded lawless ones whose day has come, an end in a time of injustice.
Turn back. Do not lodge in this place where you were born; in your own land, I will judge you.
And I will pour out my wrath upon you; in the fire of my wrath I will blow upon you and hand you over into the hands of barbarous men devising destruction.
In fire you will be food; your blood will be in the midst of your land. There will be no remembrance of you, because I, the Lord, have spoken.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
And you, son of man, will you judge the city of bloods? Then show her all her lawless deeds,
and say, Thus says the Lord God: O city pouring out bloods in her midst, so that her time may come, and making thoughts against herself so as to defile herself,

in their bloods that you poured out you have trespassed, and in your thoughts that you made you were defiled; you brought your days near and brought on the time of your years. Because of this I have given you for reproach to nations and for mockery to all lands,
those near you and those far from you. They will mock you, unclean one, well-known and abundant in lawless deeds.
Behold, the leaders of the house of Israel, each with his relatives, were mixed together in you so as to pour out blood.
Father and mother they reviled in you, and toward the sojourner they behaved unjustly. In you they oppressed orphan and widow.
And my holy things they despised, and my Sabbaths they profaned in you.
Robber men were in you so as to pour out blood in you, and on mountains they ate in you; they did impious things in your midst.
A father's shame they uncovered in you, and one set apart in uncleanness they humbled in you.
Each one acted lawlessly with the wife of his neighbor, and each one defiled his daughter-in-law in impiety, and each one humbled his sister, daughter of his father, in you.
Gifts they took in you so as to pour out blood; interest and excess they took in you, and you brought your evil to completion by oppression. But me you forgot, says the Lord.
And if I strike my hand to my hand over what you completed, what you did, and over your bloods that have come to be in your midst,
will your heart stand? Will your hands be strong in the days when I act in you? I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
And I will scatter you among nations and disperse you through lands, and your uncleanness will cease from you.
And I will allot inheritances in you before the eyes of nations, and you will know that I am the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, behold, the house of Israel has become mixed to me, all of them with bronze and iron and tin and lead in the midst of silver; it is mixed.
Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Because you all became one mixture, therefore I receive you into the midst of Jerusalem.
As silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are received into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire into it so as to be melted, so I will receive you in my wrath and gather and melt you.
And I will blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in her midst.
As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in her midst, and you will know that I, the Lord, poured out my wrath upon you.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, say to her, You are a land not rained on, nor did rain come upon you in the day of wrath.
Whose rulers in her midst are like roaring lions seizing plunder, eating souls in oppression, taking payments in injustice, and your widows were multiplied in your midst.

And her priests rejected my law and profaned my holy things; between the holy and the profane they did not distinguish, and between the unclean and the clean they did not distinguish, and from my Sabbaths they covered their eyes, and I was profaned in their midst.
Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing plunder, to pour out blood, so that greedily they may gain greed.
And her prophets who smear them over will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, Thus says the Lord, and the Lord has not spoken.
The people of the land were oppressing with injustice and plundering plunder, oppressing the poor and needy, and not behaving toward the sojourner with judgment.
And I sought from them a man walking uprightly and standing wholly before me in the time of the land, so as not to wipe it out completely, and I did not find one.
And I poured out my wrath upon her; in the fire of my wrath, to complete, I have put their ways on their heads, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
And they whored in Egypt, in their youth. There their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.
And their names were Oola the elder and Ooliba her sister, and they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria was Oola and Jerusalem Ooliba.
And Oola whored away from me and set herself on her lovers, on Assyrians near her,
clothed in blue, leaders and generals, choice young men all, horsemen mounted on horses.
And she gave her whoring to them, all choice sons of Assyria, and with all on whom she set herself, with all her thoughts, she was defiled.
And her whoring from Egypt she did not leave, because they lay with her in her youth, and they also deflowered her and poured out their whoring upon her.
Because of this I gave her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of sons of Assyria on whom she set herself.

They uncovered her shame; they took her sons and daughters, and her they killed with sword. And she became a byword among women, and they carried out acts of vengeance against her among the daughters.
And her sister Ooliba saw and corrupted her desire beyond hers and her whoring beyond her sister's whoring.
She set herself on sons of Assyria, leaders and generals near her, clothed in fine-bordered garments, horsemen riding on horses, choice young men all.
And I saw that they were defiled; one way belonged to them both.
And she added to her whoring, and saw men painted on a wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with stylus,
girded with embroidered work on their loins and dyed tiaras on their heads, all with princely appearance, likeness of sons of Chaldea, their native land.
And she set herself on them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them into the land of Chaldeans.
And sons of Babylon came to her into a lodging bed and defiled her in her whoring, and she was defiled by them, and her soul turned away from them.
And she uncovered her whoring and uncovered her shame, and my soul turned away from her, as my soul turned away from her sister.
And you multiplied your whoring so as to remember the days of your youth in which you whored in Egypt.
And you longed for Chaldeans, whose flesh was like that of donkeys and whose genitals were genitals of horses.
And you revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt, in your lodging, where your youthful breasts were.
Therefore, Ooliba, thus says the Lord: Behold, I stir up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them upon you from all around,
sons of Babylon and all Chaldeans, Phakoud and Sue and Kue, and all sons of Assyria with them, choice young men, governors and generals, all nobles and men of name, riding on horses.

And all will come against you from the north, chariots and wheels with a crowd of peoples; shields and bucklers, and they will set a guard against you all around. And I will set judgment before them, and they will take vengeance on you by their judgments.

And I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in a fury of wrath. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remnant they will cast down by sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and fire will devour your remnant.
And they will strip you of your garments and take vessels of your boasting.
And I will turn your impieties away from you, and your whoring from the land of Egypt; and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will remember no more.
Because thus says the Lord God: Behold, I hand you over into the hands of those you hate, from whom your soul turned away,
and they will deal with you in hatred and take all your labors and your toils, and you will be naked and disgraced, and the shame of your whoring, your impiety, and your whoring will be uncovered.
These things were done to you because you whored after nations and were defiled in their thoughts.
You walked in the way of your sister, and I will put her cup in your hands.
Thus says the Lord: You will drink the cup of your sister, deep and broad, overflowing so as to make an end.
You will be filled with drunkenness and collapse, a cup of desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
And you will drink it, and her feasts and her new moons I will turn away, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you forgot me and cast me behind your body, you also receive your impiety and your whoring.
And the Lord said to me, Son of man, will you not judge Oola and Ooliba and announce to them their lawless deeds?
Because they committed adultery, and blood was in their hands. With their thoughts they committed adultery, and their children whom they bore to me they passed through fire for them.
Even these things they did to me: my holy things they defiled and my Sabbaths they profaned.
And when they slaughtered their children to their idols, they entered into my holy places to profane them, and so they acted in the midst of my house.
And they sent messengers to men coming from far away, and as soon as they came you washed and painted your eyes with stibium and adorned yourself with ornament.
And you sat on a spread bed, and an adorned table was before her, and my incense and my oil were enjoyed among them.
And they struck up the sound of harmony, and to men from the multitude of the people coming from the wilderness they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of boasting on their heads.
And I said, Are they not committing adultery in these things? Works of a prostitute, and she whored.
And they went in to her as they go in to a prostitute woman; so they went in to Oola and to Ooliba, to do lawlessness.
And righteous men, they will take vengeance on them with the vengeance of adulteress and vengeance of blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is in their hands.
Thus says the Lord God: Bring up a crowd against them and give among them turmoil and plundering.
And stone them with stones of crowds and pierce them with their swords. Their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
And I will turn impiety away from the land, and all women will be disciplined and will not act according to their impieties.
And your impiety will be given upon you, and the sins of your thoughts you will receive, and you will know that I am the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
Son of man, write for yourself this day, from this day on which the king of Babylon pressed hard against Jerusalem, from this very day.
And speak a parable against the provoking house, and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Set on the cooking pot and pour water into it,
and put into it the pieces, every good piece, leg and shoulder, stripped from the bones.
taken from choice livestock, and kindle the bones under them. It boiled, boiled, and its bones were cooked in its midst.
Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloods, a pot in which there is rust, and its rust did not go out from it. Piece by piece it was brought out; no lot fell on it.
Because her blood is in her midst. Upon bare rock I placed it; I did not pour it on the ground so as to cover it with earth.
So that wrath might rise for vengeance, to take vengeance, I gave her blood upon bare rock, so that it should not be covered.
Therefore thus says the Lord: I too will enlarge the pile.
And I will multiply the wood and kindle the fire so that the flesh may melt and the broth be diminished.
And set it upon the coals so that its bronze may burn and become hot and its uncleanness may melt within it and its rust may disappear.
And her abundant rust will not go out from her; her rust will be put to shame.
Because you were defiling yourself, what if you are not cleansed any longer until I fill up my wrath?

I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not delay, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and according to your thoughts I judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I judge you according to your bloods and according to your thoughts; I judge you, the unclean one, notorious and abundant in provoking.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, behold, I take from you the desire of your eyes by an ordered stroke. You must not mourn, nor must you weep.

The groaning of blood of your loins is mourning; it will not be. Your hair will not be braided on you, and your sandals will be on your feet. You will not be comforted by their lips, and bread of men you will not eat.
And I spoke to the people in the morning as it was commanded me, and my wife died in the evening, and I did in the morning as it was ordered me.
And the people said to me, Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?
And I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I profane my holy things, the boasting of your strength, the desire of your eyes and what your souls spare, and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by sword.
And you will do as I did. You will not be comforted by their mouth, and bread of men you will not eat.
And your hair will be on your head and your sandals on your feet. You will neither mourn nor weep, and you will melt away in your injustices, and each of you will comfort his brother.
And Ezekiel will be for you a sign; according to all that he did you will do when these things come, and you will know that I am the Lord.

And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take from them their strength, the exaltation of their boasting, the desire of their eyes and the exaltation of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
on that day the one escaping will come to you to announce it in your ears?
On that day your mouth will be opened to the one escaping, and you will speak and no longer be mute, and you will be to them as a sign, and they will know that I am the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,

and say to the sons of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: Because you rejoiced over my holy things that they were profaned, and over the land of Israel that it was destroyed, and over the house of Judah that they went into captivity,

therefore behold, I give you to the sons of the east for inheritance, and they will camp with their equipment in you and pitch their tents in you. They will eat your fruits, and they will drink your richness.
And I will give the city of Ammon for a pasture for camels and the sons of Ammon for a pasture for sheep, and you will know that I am the Lord.
Because thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and stamped your foot and rejoiced with all your soul over the land of Israel,

therefore I stretch out my hand against you and give you for plunder among the nations and destroy you from the peoples and make you perish from the lands with destruction, and you will know that I am the Lord.
Thus says the Lord: Because Moab said, Behold, the house of Israel and Judah is like all the nations,
therefore behold, I weaken the shoulder of Moab from its frontier cities, the choice land: Beth-Asimouth above the spring of the city by the sea,
to the sons of the east, against the sons of Ammon, I have given them for inheritance, so that no remembrance of the sons of Ammon may come to be.
And against Moab I will do vengeance, and they will know that I am the Lord.
Thus says the Lord: Because Edom acted in taking vengeance with vengeance against the house of Judah, and they remembered wrongs and exacted a claim,
therefore thus says the Lord: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and destroy from it man and cattle and make it a wilderness, and from Teman the pursued will fall by sword.
And I will place my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will act in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath, and they will know my vengeance, says the Lord.
Therefore thus says the Lord: Because the foreigners acted in vengeance and raised up vengeance, rejoicing from the soul to wipe out forever,
therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I stretch out my hand against the foreigners and destroy the Cretans and wipe out the remnant dwelling on the coast.
And I will do great acts of vengeance among them, and they will know that I am the Lord when I give my vengeance upon them.
And it happened in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, because Tyre said against Jerusalem, Aha, she was crushed; the nations have perished; she has turned back to me; the full one has been laid waste,
therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you as the sea brings up its waves.
And they will throw down the walls of Tyre and throw down your towers, and I will winnow her dust from her and give her as bare rock.
A drying place for nets she will be in the midst of the sea, because I have spoken, says the Lord, and she will be spoil for the nations.
And her daughters in the field will be killed by sword, and they will know that I am the Lord.

Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north; he is king of kings, with horses and chariots and horsemen and a gathering of very many nations.

He will kill your daughters in the field by sword, and he will set a guard against you and build siege-works; around you he will make a trench and an encirclement of weapons, and he will set his spears opposite you.
Your walls and your towers he will throw down with his swords.

From the multitude of his horses their dust will cover you, and from the sound of his horsemen and the wheels of his chariots your walls will shake when he enters your gates, as one entering city from the plain.
With the hoofs of his horses they will trample all your streets; your people he will kill by sword, and the support of your strength he will bring down to the ground.

And he will plunder your power and spoil your possessions, and he will throw down your walls and pull down your desirable houses; your stones and your timber and your dust he will throw into the midst of the sea.
And he will end the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your psalteries will never again be heard.
And I will give you as bare rock; a drying place for nets you will be; you will never again be built, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
Because thus says the Lord God to Tyre: Will not the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when a sword is drawn in your midst?

And all rulers from the nations of the sea will come down from their thrones and take off their turbans from their heads and strip off their embroidered clothing; in astonishment they will be astonished, on the ground they will sit, and they will fear their destruction and groan over you.
And they will take up lament over you and say to you, How were you destroyed from the sea, the praised city, giving her fear to all those dwelling in her?
And the islands will fear from the day of your fall.
Because thus says the Lord God: When I make you a city laid waste, like the cities that will not be inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and much water covers you,

then I will bring you down to those going down into a pit, to the people of old, and make you dwell in the depths of the earth like everlasting desolation with those going down into a pit, so that you will not be inhabited nor arise upon the land of the living.
I will make you a destruction, and you will no longer exist forever, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, take up lamentation over Tyre,
and say to Tyre dwelling at the entrance of the sea, trading-place of peoples from many islands, Thus says the Lord to Tyre: You said, I have set my beauty around myself.
In the heart of the sea, your sons set beauty around you for Beelim.
Cedar from Senir was built for you; planks of cypress from Lebanon were taken to make fir masts for you.
From Bashan they made your oars; your sacred things they made from ivory, wooded houses from the islands of Kittim.
Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became your bedding, to put glory around you and clothe you with blue and purple from the islands of Elishah; these became your coverings.
And your rulers, those dwelling in Sidon, and Aradians became your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, who were in you, these were your pilots.
Elders of Byblos and their wise men were in you; these strengthened your counsel, and all the ships of the sea and their rowers were for you toward the farthest west.
Persians and Lydians and Libyans were in your force as your men of war; they hung shields and helmets in you; these gave you your glory.
Sons of Aradians and your force were on your walls; guards were in your towers; their quivers they hung on your battlements all around; they completed your beauty.
The Carthaginians were your merchants because of the abundance of all your strength; silver and gold and iron and tin and lead they gave to your market.
Greece and all the land and the adjacent places traded with you in souls of men, and vessels of bronze they gave to your trade.
From the house of Togarmah horses and horsemen they gave to your market.
Sons of Rhodians were your merchants; from islands they multiplied your trade with ivory teeth, and for imports you paid back your wages.
Men were your merchandise from the abundance of your mixed trade; myrrh and embroidered works from Tarshish and Ramoth and Chorchor they gave to your market.
Judah and the sons of Israel, these were your merchants. In the sale of wheat and perfumes and cassia and best honey and oil and resin they gave to your mixed trade.
Damascus was your merchant because of the abundance of all your strength, wine from Helbon and wool from Miletus.
And they gave wine to your market from Asel; worked iron and a wheel are in your mixed trade.
Dedan were your merchants with choice beasts for chariots.
Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar, these were your merchants through your hand; in camels and rams and lambs they traded with you.
Merchants of Sheba and Raamah, these were your merchants; with choice spices and precious stones and gold they gave to your market.
Haran and Canneh, these were your merchants; Asshur and Charman were your merchants,
bringing merchandise, blue cloth and choice treasures tied with cords and cypress wood.
Ships among them, Carthaginians, were your merchants in abundance in your mixed trade, and you were filled and loaded very heavily in the heart of the sea.
In much water your rowers led you; the south wind shattered you in the heart of the sea.

Your forces and your wages and your traders and your rowers and your pilots and your counselors and your dealers from among your dealers and all your men of war who are in you and all your gathering in your midst will fall in the heart of the sea on the day of your fall.
At the sound of your cry your pilots will fear with fear.
And all your rowers and passengers and helmsmen of the sea will come down from the ships and stand on the land.
And they will howl over you with their voice and cry bitterly and put earth on their heads and spread ashes beneath themselves.
And their sons will take up a lament over you and a lamentation for you:
What kind of wages did you find from the sea? You filled nations from your abundance, and from your mixed trade you enriched all the kings of the earth.
Now you were shattered in the sea, in the depth of water; your mixed trade and all your gathering in your midst fell; all your rowers fell.
All those dwelling on the islands were appalled over you, and their kings stood in astonishment, and their faces wept.
Merchants from the nations hissed at you; you became a destruction and will no longer exist forever.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

And you, son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, Thus says the Lord: Because your heart was exalted and you said, I am God; I have dwelt in the dwelling of God in the heart of the sea, but you are a man and not God, and you set your heart as the heart of God,
Are you wiser than Daniel? Have wise men not instructed you in their knowledge?
Was it not by your knowledge or by your understanding that you gained power for yourself, and gold and silver in your treasuries?
In your abundant knowledge and your trade you multiplied your power; your heart was exalted in your power.
Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you set your heart as the heart of God,

because of this, behold, I bring against you foreign scourges from nations, and they will draw their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge, and they will lay your beauty down to destruction.
And they will bring you down, and you will die the death of the wounded in the heart of the sea.
Will you indeed say, I am God, before those killing you? But you are a man and not God among a multitude.
You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hands of foreigners, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, take up a lamentation over the ruler of Tyre and say to him, Thus says the Lord God: You are a seal of likeness and a crown of beauty.

You came to be in the delight of the paradise of God. You clothed yourself with every precious stone: sardius and topaz and emerald and carbuncle and sapphire and jasper and silver and gold and ligurion and agate and amethyst and chrysolite and beryl and onyx; and with gold you filled your treasures and your storehouses within you from the day you were created.
With the cherub I placed you on the holy mountain of God; you came to be in the midst of fiery stones.
You were blameless in your days from the day you were created until injustices were found in you.
From the abundance of your trade you filled your storehouses with lawlessness and sinned, and you were wounded from the mountain of God, and the cherub led you out from the midst of fiery stones.

Your heart was exalted because of your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted with your beauty. Because of the multitude of your sins I cast you upon the ground; before kings I gave you to be made an example.

Because of the multitude of your sins and the injustices of your trade you profaned your holy things, and I will bring out fire from your midst; this will devour you, and I will give you as ashes on your land before all those seeing you.
And all those who know you among the nations will shudder over you; you became a destruction and will no longer exist forever.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you, and you will know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you and am sanctified in you.
Blood and death will be in your streets, and wounded ones will fall by swords in you, all around you, and they will know that I am the Lord.
And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a thorn of bitterness and a pricking briar of pain from all those around them who dishonored them, and they will know that I am the Lord.

Thus says the Lord God: And I will gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered, and I will be sanctified in them before the peoples and the nations, and they will dwell on their land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

And they will dwell on it in hope and build houses and plant vineyards and dwell in hope, when I execute judgment against all those dishonoring them around them, and they will know that I am the Lord their God and the God of their fathers.
In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, the great dragon sitting in the midst of his rivers, saying, The rivers are mine, and I made them.
And I will put hooks in your jaws and fasten the fish of your river to your fins and bring you up from the midst of your river, and all the fish of your river,

and I will quickly cast you down upon the face of the plain, along with all the fish of your river. You will fall and not be gathered or collected; I have given you for food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven.
And all those inhabiting Egypt will know that I am the Lord, because you became a reed-staff for the house of Israel.
When they took hold of you with their hands, you were crushed, and when every hand seized hold on them and when they leaned on you, you were shattered and broke all their loins.
Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring a sword upon you and will destroy men and cattle from you.
And the land of Egypt will be a destruction and a wilderness, and they will know that I am the Lord, because you said, The rivers are mine, and I made them.

Therefore behold, I am against you and against all your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt a wilderness, a sword, and a destruction from Migdol and Syene and as far as the borders of the Ethiopians.
The foot of a man will not pass through it, and the foot of a beast will not pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.

And I will make its land a destruction in the midst of a desolated land, and its cities will be desolated forty years in the midst of desolated cities, and I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the lands.
Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered,
and I will turn back the captivity of the Egyptians and settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were taken, and it will be a humble dominion.
Beyond all dominions it will no longer be exalted over the nations, and I will make them few, so that they will not be many among the nations.
And they will no longer be for the house of Israel a hope recalling lawlessness when they follow after them, and they will know that I am the Lord.
And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, made his force serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was bald and every shoulder peeled raw, and no wages came to him or to his force from Tyre for the service that they served against her.
Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I give to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, the land of Egypt, and he will plunder its plunder and spoil its spoils, and it will be the wages for his force.
In return for the service with which he served against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt, thus says the Lord God.
On that day a horn will spring up for the whole house of Israel, and to you I will give an open mouth in their midst, and they will know that I am the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Woe, woe to the day,
because the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of the end of nations.
And a sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia, and wounded ones will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse.
Persians and Cretans and Lydians and Libyans and all the mixed peoples and the sons of my covenant will fall by the sword in it.
And the supports of Egypt will fall, and the arrogance of her strength will go down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword in her, says the Lord.
And it will be made desolate in the midst of desolated lands, and their cities will be desolated in the midst of desolated cities.
And they will know that I am the Lord when I send fire upon Egypt and all those helping her are crushed.
On that day messengers will go out hastening to destroy Ethiopia, and turmoil will be among them on the day of Egypt, because behold, it comes.
Thus says the Lord God: And I will destroy the multitude of Egyptians by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
By his hand and by the hand of his people, scourges from nations sent to destroy the land, they will all draw their swords against Egypt, and the land will be filled with the wounded.
And I will make their rivers desolate and destroy the land and its fullness by the hands of foreigners. I, the Lord, have spoken.
For thus says the Lord God: And I will destroy nobles from Memphis and rulers from the land of Egypt, and they will no longer be.
And I will destroy the land of Pathros and send fire upon Zoan and execute vengeance in Diospolis.
And I will pour out my wrath upon Sais, the strength of Egypt, and destroy the multitude of Memphis.
And I will send fire upon Egypt, and Syene will be troubled with turmoil, and there will be a breach in Diospolis, and waters will be poured out.
Young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the women will go into captivity.

And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I break the scepters of Egypt there, and the arrogance of her strength will perish there, and a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will be led away captive.
And I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord.
And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, I broke the arms of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and behold, it was not bound up for healing, to have salve put on it, to be given strength to seize a sword.
Therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and will break his strong and outstretched arms and cast his sword from his hand.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the lands.
And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and give my sword into his hand, and he will bring it against Egypt and plunder its plunder and spoil its spoils.

And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall, and they will know that I am the Lord when I give my sword into the hands of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out over the land of Egypt.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the lands, and they all will know that I am the Lord.
And it happened in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to his multitude: To whom did you liken yourself in your height?
Behold, Assyria was a cypress in Lebanon, beautiful in boughs and great in size; his top came to be in the midst of clouds.
Water nourished him; the deep exalted him. It led its rivers around his plants and sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
Because of this his stature was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his branches spread wide because of much water.
In his boughs all the birds of heaven nested, and under his branches all the beasts of the field gave birth; the whole multitude of nations dwelt in his shade.
And he became beautiful in his height because of the multitude of his branches, because his roots reached much water.
No cypresses like these were in the paradise of God, and pines were not like his boughs, and firs were not like his branches; no tree in the paradise of God was like him in his beauty.
Because of the multitude of his branches, the trees of the paradise of God's delight envied him.
Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you became great in stature and set your top into the midst of clouds, and I saw when he was exalted,
I delivered him into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he brought about his destruction.

And foreign scourges from nations destroyed him and cast him down upon the mountains; in all the ravines his branches fell, and his stems were broken in every plain of the land, and all the peoples of the nations came down from their shelter and laid him low.
Upon his fall all the birds of heaven rested, and upon his stems all the beasts of the field came,

so that all the trees by the water might not be exalted in their size; they did not set their top into the midst of clouds, and all those drinking water did not stand in their height before them. All were given to death, into the depth of the earth, in the midst of sons of men, with those going down into the pit.

Thus says the Lord God: On the day he went down to Hades, the deep mourned for him, and I restrained its rivers and held back much water, and Lebanon grew dark over him; all the trees of the field fainted over him.

At the sound of his fall the nations shook, when I brought him down to Hades with those going down into the pit, and all the trees of delight, the choice things of Lebanon, all drinking water, comforted him in the earth.
For they also went down with him to Hades, among those wounded by the sword, and his seed, those dwelling under his shelter in the midst of their life, perished.

To whom were you likened? Go down and be brought down with the trees of delight into the depth of the earth. In the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie with the wounded by the sword. Thus are Pharaoh and all the multitude of his strength, says the Lord God.
And it happened in the eleventh year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and say to him: You were likened to a lion of nations, and you were like a dragon in the sea, and you gored with your rivers and troubled water with your feet and trampled your rivers.
Thus says the Lord: And I will spread over you nets of many peoples and bring you up with my hook.
And I will stretch you out on the land; the plains will be filled with you, and I will make all the birds of heaven settle upon you, and from you I will fill all the beasts of the whole earth.
And I will put your flesh upon the mountains and fill them with your blood.
And the land will be watered from your dung, from your multitude upon the mountains; I will fill ravines from you.
And when you are extinguished I will cover heaven and darken its stars; the sun I will cover with a cloud, and the moon will not show its light.
All the shining lights in heaven will darken over you, and I will give darkness on your land, says the Lord God.
And I will provoke the heart of many peoples when I lead your captivity among the nations to a land that you did not know.
And many nations will shudder over you, and their kings will stand astonished when my sword flies before their faces, awaiting their fall from the day of your fall.
Because thus says the Lord: The sword of the king of Babylon will come to you.
With swords of giants I will bring down your strength; scourges from nations, all of them, will destroy the arrogance of Egypt, and all her strength will be crushed.
And I will destroy all her cattle from beside much water, and a human foot will no longer trouble it, and the track of cattle will no longer trample it.
Thus then their waters will become calm, and their rivers will flow like oil, says the Lord.
When I make Egypt a destruction and the land is desolated with its fullness, when I scatter all those dwelling in it, then they will know that I am the Lord.
It is a lamentation, and you will lament it; the daughters of the nations will lament it over Egypt, and over all her strength they will lament her, says the Lord God.
And it happened in the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, lament over the strength of Egypt, and the nations will bring down her daughters dead into the depth of the earth, to those going down into the pit.
In the midst of those wounded by the sword they will fall with him, and all his strength will lie down.
And the giants in the depth of the pit will say to you, Whom are you better than? Go down and lie with the uncircumcised in the midst of those wounded by the sword.

There is Assyria and all his gathering, all the wounded. There they were given, and their burial is in the depth of the pit, and his gathering was around his tomb, all the wounded, those fallen by the sword,
those who gave their fear upon the land of the living.

There is Elam and all his force around his tomb, all the wounded, those fallen by the sword and going down uncircumcised into the depth of the earth, those who gave their fear upon the land of the living, and they bore their torment with those going down into the pit.
In the midst of the wounded.
There were given Meshech and Tubal and all their strength around his tomb, all his wounded, all uncircumcised, wounded by the sword, those who gave their fear upon the land of the living.

And they lay with the giants fallen of old, who went down into Hades with the weapons of war, and they placed their swords under their heads, and their lawless deeds came upon their bones, because they terrified giants in the land of the living.
And you will lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword.
There were given the rulers of Assyria, those giving his strength to a wound of the sword; these slept with the wounded, with those going down into the pit.

There are the rulers of the north, all generals of Assyria, those going down wounded; with their fear and their strength they slept uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword, and they bore their torment with those going down into the pit.
King Pharaoh will see those and be comforted over all their strength, says the Lord God.
Because I have given his fear upon the land of the living, and Pharaoh and all his multitude will lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and say to them: A land upon which I bring a sword, and the people of the land take one man from among them and give him to themselves as a watchman,
and he sees the sword coming upon the land and sounds with the trumpet and signals the people,
and the one hearing hears the sound of the trumpet and does not guard himself, and the sword comes and overtakes him, his blood will be on his own head.
Because he heard the sound of the trumpet and did not guard himself, his blood will be on him. But this one, because he guarded himself, rescued his own life.

And if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not guard themselves, and the sword comes and takes a life from them, that one was taken because of his own lawlessness, but his blood I will seek from the hand of the watchman.
And you, son of man, I have given you as a watchman to the house of Israel, and you will hear a word from my mouth.

When I say to the sinner, By death you will be put to death, and you do not speak to guard the impious one from his way, that lawless one will die in his lawlessness, but his blood I will seek from your hand.
But if you warn the impious one about his way, to turn from it, and he does not turn from his way, this one will die in his impiety, but you have rescued your own life.
And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, Thus you have spoken, saying, Our wanderings and our lawless deeds are upon us, and in them we melt away, and how shall we live?

Say to them, As I live, thus says the Lord, I do not desire the death of the impious one, but rather that the impious one turn from his way and live. Turn back, turn back from your way, and why are you dying, house of Israel?

Say to the sons of your people, The righteousness of a righteous one will not rescue him on the day when he wanders, and the lawlessness of an impious one will not hurt him on the day when he turns from his lawlessness, and a righteous one will not be able to be saved.

When I say to the righteous one, 'He will surely live,' and he trusts in his righteousness and does lawlessness, all his righteous deeds will not be remembered; in the injustice that he did, in it he will die.
And when I say to the impious one, 'By death you will be put to death,' and he turns from his sin and does judgment and righteousness,
and returns a pledge and repays plunder and walks in ordinances of life, so as not to do injustice, living he will live; he will not die.
None of all his sins that he sinned will be remembered, because he did judgment and righteousness; in them he will live.
And the sons of your people will say, The way of the Lord is not straight, but this way of theirs is not straight.
When a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does lawless deeds, he will die in them.
And when the sinner turns from his lawlessness and does judgment and righteousness, in them he himself will live.
And this is what you said: The way of the Lord is not straight. I will judge each one of you according to his ways, house of Israel.
And it happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month of our captivity, the one who had escaped came to me from Jerusalem, saying, The city has been taken.
And the hand of the Lord came upon me in the evening before he came, and he opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning, and my mouth, having been opened, was no longer restrained.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, those dwelling in the desolated places on the land of Israel say, Abraham was one and possessed the land, and we are more numerous; to us the land has been given as a possession.
Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord God.

As I live, surely those in the desolated places will fall by the sword, and those on the face of the plain will be given to the beasts of the field for food, and those in the fortified places and those in the caves I will kill with death.
And I will make the land a desolation, and the arrogance of its strength will perish, and the mountains of Israel will be desolated because there is no one passing through.
And they will know that I am the Lord when I make their land a desolation, and it will be desolated because of all their abominations that they did.

And you, son of man, the sons of your people are those speaking about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses, and they speak, each man to his brother, saying, Let us come together and hear the things going out from the Lord.
They come to you as a people comes together and sit before you and hear your words, but they will not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth and their heart is behind their defilements.
And you become to them like the sound of a sweet-sounding, well-harmonized psaltery, and they will hear your words but not do them.
And whenever it comes, they will say, Behold, it has come, and they will know that a prophet was in their midst.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say to the shepherds, Thus says the Lord God: Woe, shepherds of Israel. Do the shepherds feed themselves? Do not the shepherds feed the sheep?
Behold, you eat the milk and clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fat one, but my sheep you do not feed.

The weak one you did not strengthen, and the sick one you did not heal, and the broken one you did not bind up, and the straying one you did not turn back, and the lost one you did not seek, and the strong one you wore down with toil.
And my sheep were scattered because there were no shepherds and became food for all the beasts of the field.
And my sheep were scattered on every mountain and on every high hill, and over the face of all the earth they were scattered, and there was no one seeking them and no one turning them back.
Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the Lord.

As I live, says the Lord God, surely because my sheep became plunder and my sheep became food for all the beasts of the field because there were no shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out my sheep, and the shepherds fed themselves, but my sheep they did not feed,
Because of this, shepherds,

Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will require my sheep from their hands and turn them away so that they do not shepherd my sheep, and the shepherds will no longer feed them; and I will rescue my sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.
Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I myself will seek out my sheep and attend to them.

As the shepherd seeks his flock on a day when gloom and cloud are amid scattered sheep, so I will seek out my sheep and drive them out from every place where they were scattered, on a day of cloud and gloom.

And I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the lands and bring them into their land and feed them on the mountains of Israel and in the ravines and in every habitation of the land.

In good pasture I will feed them, and on the high mountain of Israel their folds will be there; there they will lie down, and there they will rest in good delight, and in rich pasture they will be fed on the mountains of Israel.
I myself will feed my sheep, and I myself will give them rest, and they will know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord God.

The lost one I will seek, and the straying one I will turn back, and the broken one I will bind up, and the fainting one I will strengthen, and the strong one I will guard, and I will feed them with judgment.
And you, sheep, thus says the Lord God: Behold, I myself judge between sheep and sheep, between rams and he-goats.
And is it not enough for you that you grazed the good pasture and trampled the rest of your pasture with your feet, and drank the settled water and troubled the rest with your feet?
And my sheep fed on the tramplings of your feet and drank the water troubled under your feet.
Therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I judge between the strong sheep and the weak sheep.
With your sides and with your shoulders you pushed, and with your horns you gored, and every fainting one you pressed out.
And I will save my sheep, and they will no longer be for plunder, and I will judge between ram and ram.
And I will raise up over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will shepherd them, and he will be their shepherd.
And I, the Lord, will be to them for God, and David will be a ruler in their midst. I, the Lord, have spoken.
And I will make with David a covenant of peace and destroy evil beasts from the land, and they will dwell in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.
And I will place them around my mountain and give you the rain, a rain of blessing.

And the trees in the field will give their fruit, and the land will give its strength, and they will dwell upon their land in hope of peace and know that I am the Lord when I break their yoke and rescue them from the hand of those enslaving them.
And they will no longer be for plunder to the nations, and the beasts of the earth will never again eat them, and they will dwell in hope, and there will be no one frightening them.
And I will raise up for them a plant of peace, and they will no longer perish by famine upon the land and will no longer bear the reproach of nations.
And they will know that I am the Lord their God, and that they are my people, the house of Israel, says the Lord.
You are my sheep, the sheep of my flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, turn your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
and say, Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as a wilderness, and you will be desolated.
And I will make your cities a desolation, and you will be desolate and know that I am the Lord.
Because you became a perpetual enemy and laid ambush against the house of Israel with deceit, by the hand of enemies with a sword, in the time of injustice, at the end,
Therefore, as I live, says the Lord God, surely you sinned unto blood, and blood will pursue you.
And I will make Mount Seir into a wilderness and a desolated place and destroy from it men and cattle.
And I will fill your hills and your ravines with your wounded, and in all your plains those wounded by the sword will fall within you.
I will make you an everlasting desolation, and your cities will never again be inhabited, and you will know that I am the Lord.
Because you said, The two nations and the two lands will be mine, and I will inherit them, and the Lord is there,
Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, I will do to you according to your enmity and will be made known to you when I judge you.
And you will know that I am the Lord; I heard the voice of your blasphemies, because you said, The mountains of Israel are desolate; they have been given to us for food.
And you spoke arrogantly against me with your mouth; I heard.
Thus says the Lord: In the joy of the whole earth I will make you a desolation.
You will be a desolation, Mount Seir, and all Edom will be utterly consumed, and you will know that I am the Lord their God.
And you, son of man, prophesy over the mountains of Israel and say to the mountains of Israel, Hear the word of the Lord.
Thus says the Lord God: Because the enemy said against you, Aha, everlasting desolations have become ours as a possession,

Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord God: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you were a possession to the remaining nations, and you rose as talk on the tongue and as a reproach among nations,

Therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the torrents and to the desolated and ruined places and to the abandoned cities, which became for plunder and for trampling to the remaining nations around,

Therefore thus says the Lord God: Surely in the fire of my wrath I spoke against the remaining nations and against all Edom, because they gave my land to themselves as a possession with joy, dishonoring souls, so as to destroy it for plunder.

Therefore prophesy over the land of Israel and say to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, in my zeal and in my wrath I spoke because you bore reproaches of nations.
Therefore I myself lift up my hand against the nations around you; they themselves will bear their dishonor.
But you, mountains of Israel, my people will eat your grapes and your fruit, because they are drawing near to come.
Because behold, I am for you and will look upon you, and you will be worked and sown.
And I will multiply upon you men, all the house of Israel to the end, and cities will be inhabited and the desolated land will be built.
And I will multiply upon you men and cattle and settle you as at your beginning and do good to you like your former times, and you will know that I am the Lord.
And I will cause men, my people Israel, to be born upon you, and they will inherit you, and you will be to them as a possession and will no longer again be bereaved of them.
Thus says the Lord God: Because they said to you, You devour men and have become bereaved of your nation,
therefore you will no longer devour men, and you will no longer bereave your nation, says the Lord God.
And the reproach of nations will no longer be heard against you, and the reproaches of peoples you will no longer bear, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, the house of Israel dwelt on their land and defiled it by their way and with their idols and with their uncleannesses; according to the uncleanness of a woman set apart, their way became before me.
And I poured out my wrath upon them.
And I scattered them among the nations and winnowed them into the lands; according to their way and according to their sin I judged them.
And they entered into the nations, wherever they entered there, and profaned my holy name when it was said of them, These are the people of the Lord, and they came out of his land.
And I spared them for the sake of my holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations where they entered there.

Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Not for your sake do I act, O house of Israel, but for the sake of my holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered there.
And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you profaned in their midst, and the nations will know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
And I will take you from the nations and gather you from all the lands and bring you into your land.
And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and from all your idols, and I will cleanse you.
And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will give within you, and I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
And my Spirit I will give within you and make you walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them.
And you will dwell on the land that I gave to your fathers, and you will be to me for a people and I will be to you for God.
And I will save you from all your uncleannesses and call for the grain and multiply it and I will not give famine upon you.
And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field so that you no longer receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
And you will remember your evil ways and your practices that were not good and loathe yourselves before your faces for your lawless deeds and for your abominations.
Not for your sake do I act, says the Lord God; it will be made known to you. Be ashamed and be confounded from your ways, O house of Israel.
Thus says the Lord: On the day when I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds and cause the cities to be inhabited, the desolate places will be built,
and the land that was desolated will be worked, because it had become desolated before the eyes of every passerby.
And they will say, That land which was desolated became like a garden of delight, and the desolate and ruined and torn-down cities sat fortified.
And the nations that are left around you will know that I, the Lord, built the torn-down places and planted the desolated places. I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
Thus says the Lord: Still for this I will be sought by the house of Israel, to do for them: I will multiply them like sheep, men.
As holy sheep, as the sheep of Jerusalem in her feasts, so the desolate cities will be filled with flocks of men, and they will know that I am the Lord.
And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and the Lord brought me out in the Spirit and set me in the midst of the plain, and it was full of human bones.
And he led me around over them, all around, and behold, they were very many on the face of the plain, very dry.
And he said to me, Son of man, will these bones live? And I said, O Lord, you know these things.
And he said to me, Prophesy over these bones, and you will say to them, Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.
Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I am bringing the spirit of life into you.
And I will put sinews on you and bring up flesh upon you and stretch skin over you and give my Spirit into you, and you will live, and you will know that I am the Lord.
And I prophesied as he commanded me, and it happened, while I prophesied, and behold, there was a shaking, and the bones came together, each to its joint.
And I saw, and behold, sinews and flesh were growing upon them, and skin was rising over them above, but there was no spirit in them.
And he said to me, Prophesy, son of man, prophesy to the spirit, and say to the spirit, Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead ones, and let them live.
And I prophesied as he commanded me, and the spirit entered into them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, a very great gathering.
And the Lord spoke to me, saying, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel, and they say, Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished, we are cut off.
Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I open your tombs and bring you up from your tombs and bring you into the land of Israel.
And you will know that I am the Lord when I open your graves, when I bring my people up from the graves.
And I will give my Spirit into you and you will live, and I will place you on your land, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it, says the Lord.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

Son of man, take for yourself a rod and write on it, Judah and the sons of Israel attached to him, and take for yourself a second rod and write on it, Joseph, rod of Ephraim, and all the sons of Israel added to him.
And join them to one another for yourself into one rod, to bind them, and they will be in your hand.
And it will be when the sons of your people say to you, Will you not tell us what these things are to you?

Then you will say to them, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I take the tribe of Joseph from the hand of Ephraim and the tribes of Israel attached to him, and I will place them upon the tribe of Judah, and they will be one rod in the hand of Judah.
And the rods on which you wrote will be in your hand before them.

And you will say to them, Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I take the whole house of Israel from the midst of the nations where they entered there, and I will gather them from all those around them and bring them into the land of Israel.
And I will make them one nation in my land and on the mountains of Israel, and one ruler will be over them, and they will no longer be two nations, nor be divided any longer into two kingdoms.

So that they no longer may defile themselves with their idols, and I will rescue them from all their lawless deeds in which they sinned, and I will cleanse them, and they will be to me for a people, and I, the Lord, will be to them for God.
And my servant David will be ruler in their midst, and one shepherd will be for all, because they will walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them.
And they will dwell on their land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt there, and they will dwell on it, they and David my servant, and he will be their ruler forever.
And I will make with them a covenant of peace; an everlasting covenant will be with them, and I will put my holy things in their midst forever.
And my dwelling will be among them, and I will be to them for God, and they will be to me for a people.
And the nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when my holy things are in their midst forever.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Gog and the land of Magog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
And say to him, Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
And I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen clothed in breastplates, all of them a great gathering, shields and helmets and swords,
Persians and Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and shields,
Gomer and all those around him, the house of Togarmah from the farthest north and all those around him, and many nations with you.
Be prepared; prepare yourself, you and your whole assembly gathered with you, and you will be to me for a guard.

After many days he will be prepared, and in latter years he will come and enter into the land brought back from the sword, with people gathered from many nations onto the land of Israel, which had become entirely desolate; and this people came out from nations, and they all will dwell in peace.
And you will come up like rain and arrive like a cloud to cover the land, you and all those around you, and many nations with you.
Thus says the Lord God: And it will be on that day, words will come up upon your heart, and you will devise evil plans,

and say, I will go up against a land thrown open; I will come against those quiet in stillness and dwelling in peace, all dwelling in a land where there is no wall, and neither bars nor gates are theirs,

to plunder plunder and seize spoils, to turn your hand against the desolated place that was resettled, and against a nation gathered from many nations, making possessions, dwelling on the navel of the earth.

Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Carthage and all their villages will say to you, Is it for plunder that you have come, and to spoil spoils? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, to carry off possessions, to spoil spoils?
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord: Is it not on that day, when my people Israel are settled in peace, that you will rise up?
And you will come from your place, from the farthest north, and many nations with you, all riding horses, a great assembly and much force.

And you will come up against my people Israel like a cloud to cover the land; it will be in the last days, and I will bring you upon my land so that all the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you before them.
Thus says the Lord God to Gog: Are you the one concerning whom I spoke in former days through the hand of my servants, the prophets of Israel, in those days and years, to bring you upon them?
And it will be on that day, on the day when Gog comes upon the land of Israel, says the Lord God, my wrath will rise up.
And in my zeal, in the fire of my anger, I spoke: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon the land of Israel.
